name: Data Analyzer: A corrupt Excel upload gets a fixed, safe error message
objective: Shows internal library wording is never shown to the caller.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; analysis steps that would call out are replaced by stand-ins. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Upload a file named x.xlsx whose bytes are not a real Excel file.
steps.expected: HTTP 400 with the exact error 'Failed to parse the uploaded .xlsx file. Check that it is a valid file of that type.' and no mention of 'engine' or 'openpyxl' in the reply.

name: Data Analyzer: An unexpected analysis crash gives a fixed message and a request ID, not internal details
objective: Shows the real error text stays hidden but support can trace it using the ID.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; analysis steps that would call out are replaced by stand-ins. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Make the checks fail with an error whose text includes a made-up sensitive value, then upload a tiny CSV.
steps.expected: HTTP 500; the value is absent from the reply; the error is 'Unexpected error while analysing the data.'; the reply carries a request_id equal to the X-Request-ID response header.

name: Data Analyzer: The request ID is made by the server, not copied from the caller
objective: Shows a caller cannot forge log lines by supplying their own ID containing line breaks.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; analysis steps that would call out are replaced by stand-ins. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Send a request with a wrong API key and an X-Request-ID containing a fake log line.
steps.expected: HTTP 403; the returned request_id differs from the forged one and matches the response header.

name: Data Analyzer: Logs of failed uploads contain no file name and no data values
objective: Shows private information (such as participant IDs in file names) does not end up in logs.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; analysis steps that would call out are replaced by stand-ins. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Upload a badly formed CSV with a sensitive-looking file name and cell value, then a bad xlsx with the same name pattern.
steps.expected: The collected logs contain neither the file name, 'subject-9876', nor the value, but do contain the safe marker 'analysis_parse_failed'.

name: Data Analyzer: Logs of a successful analysis contain no file name
objective: Shows the file name is kept out of logs even when everything works.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; analysis steps that would call out are replaced by stand-ins. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Upload a tiny valid CSV with a sensitive-looking file name.
steps.expected: HTTP 200 and the logs do not contain 'subject-9876'.

name: Data Analyzer: Dictionary upload errors and logs omit the file name and AI error text
objective: Shows a failing dictionary parse neither logs the file name nor returns the AI service's message.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; analysis steps that would call out are replaced by stand-ins. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Make dictionary creation fail with an error containing a made-up sensitive value and upload a dictionary with a sensitive-looking name.
steps.data: File subject-9876-jane.csv; error text with PHI-VALUE-4242
steps.expected: HTTP 500, error 'Dictionary parsing failed.', the value is absent from the reply, and neither 'subject-9876' nor the value is in the logs.

name: Data Analyzer: Dictionary lookups strip line breaks from the requested ID in logs
objective: Shows a caller cannot insert a forged log line through the ID in the web address.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; analysis steps that would call out are replaced by stand-ins. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Request a dictionary whose ID contains an encoded line break and fake log text (the store reports not found).
steps.data: ID: abc, newline, INFO forged entry
steps.expected: HTTP 404; the log has the text on one line ('abc?INFO forged entry') and no line break after 'abc'.

name: Data Analyzer: A database failure during lookup returns a fixed message
objective: Shows disk paths and internal wording are not leaked on a database error.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; analysis steps that would call out are replaced by stand-ins. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Make the program store fail with a message holding a made-up path and value, then look up a dictionary.
steps.expected: HTTP 500, error 'Database error.', and the value is absent.

name: Data Analyzer: A malformed 'schema' field gets a generic rejection without echoing the input
objective: Shows invalid JSON typed in the schema box is rejected without repeating it back.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; analysis steps that would call out are replaced by stand-ins. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Upload a CSV with a schema field that is not valid JSON and contains a made-up sensitive value.
steps.expected: HTTP 400 and the value does not appear in the reply.

name: Data Analyzer: Invalid base64 data gets a fixed message
objective: Shows badly encoded inline data is refused with a clear, stable message.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; analysis steps that would call out are replaced by stand-ins. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Send inline-data analysis with encoding base64 but data that is not base64.
steps.expected: HTTP 400 with the error "Invalid base64 in 'data_content'."

name: Data Analyzer: A stray internal ValueError is turned into a generic 'Invalid input'
objective: Shows an unexpected input error never exposes its own wording.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; analysis steps that would call out are replaced by stand-ins. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Add a test-only web address that raises a ValueError containing a made-up value, then call it.

name: Data Analyzer: Debug mode does not reveal error details when deployed
objective: Shows turning on DEBUG by mistake in production still hides internal errors.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; analysis steps that would call out are replaced by stand-ins. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Set DEBUG=true and APP_ENV=prod, add a test-only address that raises an error with a made-up value, and call it.
steps.expected: HTTP 500, the value is absent, and the detail is exactly 'An unexpected error occurred'.

name: Data Analyzer: Debug mode still gives details on a developer's own machine
objective: Shows the safety measure does not break normal developer debugging.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; analysis steps that would call out are replaced by stand-ins. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Set DEBUG=true with every deployed-environment setting removed, add a test-only address raising an error, and call it.
steps.expected: HTTP 500 and the detail text includes 'local-detail'.

name: Data Analyzer: The 'file too large' (HTTP 413) reply also has a server-made request ID
objective: Shows even size-limit refusals are traceable and cannot be given a forged ID.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key; analysis steps that would call out are replaced by stand-ins. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Set the upload limit to 100 bytes and upload a larger CSV with a client-chosen request ID.
steps.expected: HTTP 413 and the returned request_id is not 'client-chosen'.
